bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears made a statement on Monday Night Football, dominating the Super Bowl Champion Seattle Seahawks 34-17 on the road as underdogs , with new acquisition Jeffery Simmons making an immediate impact by recording a sack in his Bears debut. The win, combined with losses by the Minnesota Vikings and Seattle Seahawks, put Chicago in great playoff position as the team continues to be viewed as a legitimate Super Bowl contender.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The biggest Lions story from the last 24 hours centers on linebacker Jack Campbell, who remained hospitalized Monday as team officials hinted that the standout defender was recovering from a scary injury he sustained Sunday , after being carted off the field in Detroit's win over Minnesota. packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers made a roster move on Monday, bringing in former Las Vegas Raiders quarterback Cam Miller to add depth at the position, while confirming they are keeping running back Josh Jacobs despite recent trade speculation. The move comes with Green Bay fresh off beating the Carolina Panthers on Thursday Night Football, improving to 5-3 overall but still in fourth place in the NFC North standings.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings saw their undefeated season come to an end as the team fell to the Detroit Lions 19-15 at Ford Field, moving to 6-1 on the season , with a late-game decision to punt on 4th-and-4 drawing scrutiny afterward. The loss exposed ongoing issues on offense, as pressure may only increase on head coach Kevin O'Connell after the Vikings offense struggled again , while quarterback Kyler Murray's performance and accuracy issues have become a focal point heading into the team's difficult upcoming schedule.
